svg.title: IL-SCAF-011 Interlock end card
svg.desc: Three columns kept separate: controlled causal proof HAC-330, real Google Cloud participation HAC-340, and immutable evidence published under HAC-342. Two runs, two proof classes, neither evidence for the other. Agent Runtime, Agent Gateway and CONTENT_AUTHZ are not on the recorded path.
